item_short_desc: Rothco's Deluxe "Concealed Weapons Permit" Badge is a professional and durable badge designed for license holders. Made from high-quality silver zinc alloy with a nickel plating, this CCW badge offers a sleek and polished appearance. The badge features a clear and prominent "Concealed Weapons Permit" inscription, making it easy to identify. It comes with a sturdy pin back for secure attachment to your clothing, bag, or gear. The robust construction ensures that the conceal carry badge can withstand daily wear and tear.
